name: NetRačuni for WooCommerce
author: danielwdev

sections.description:
[Serbian]

NetRačuni je online fiskalna kasa za online biznise.
Ovaj plugin omogućava izdavanje fiskalnih računa sa klikom na dugme iz WooCommerce prodavnice.

Podešavanje

Nakon registracije u sistemu NetRačuni, napravite API token prema uputsvu.
Otvorite podešavanja WooCommerce/Settings/NetRačuni i upišite (kopirajte) API key u polje API token.
Izaberite okruženje, da li želite koristiti test server ili live server.
Nakon uspešnog snimanja tokena (klik na dugme Save changes), u sekciji status pojavi se zelena tačkica, što znači da je
vaša prodavnica uspešno povezana sa NetRačuni serverom.

Poreske stope

Nakon uspešnog povezivanja sa NetRačuni serverom, pojave se opcije za podešavanje poreskih stopa.

Podešavanje podrazumevane poreske stope
Ova poreska stopa će se koristiti za proizvode, koji nemaju podešenu poresku stopu.
Ako svi vaši proizvodi koriste istu poresku stopu, dovoljno je podesiti samo podrazumevanu poresku stopu.

Poreske stope po proizvodima kada je isključen ugrađeni tax modul
Ako vaši proizvodi imaju različite poreske stope, to možete podesiti u detaljima proizvoda, na tabu NetRačuni. Po specifikaciji
Poreske Uprave Srbije, moguće je dodati više poreskih stopa za jedan proizvod.
Kada je uljučen ugrađeni Tax modul WooCommerce-a, NetRačuni tab se ne pojavljuje u detaljima proizvoda.

Korišćenje ugrađenog WooCommerce tax modula
Kad je uključen ugrađeni WooCommerce “Tax” modul, sve poreske stope treba povezati sa poreskim stopama poreske uprave.
Za svaki tax rate izaberite odgovarajuću poresku stopu poreske uprave. Vodite računa da procenat poreske stope iz WooCommerce
tax modula bude jednako sa poreskim stopom iz poreske uprave, u protivnom kalkulacija poreza će biti različita u prodavnici
i na fiskalnom računu!

Načini plaćanja

Podešavanje podrazumevanog načina plaćanja
Ovaj način plaćanja će se koristiti na računu kada je ugrađeni “Payment methods” isključeni, a uključen je automatsko izdavanje
računa u NetRačuni podešavanjima. Kada se koristi manuelno izdavanje računa, ovaj način plaćanja će biti unapred selektovan kod kreiranja računa.

Korišćenje ugrađenog načina plaćanja
Kad je uključen ugrađeni WooCommerce “Payment methods” modul, sve načine plaćanja treba povezati sa načinima plaćanja poreske uprave.
Za svaki payment method izaberite odgovarajući način plaćanja poreske uprave. Kada je uključen automatsko izdavanje računa,
na računu će se koristiti odgovarajući način plaćanja koju je kupac izabrao tokom kupovine. Kada se koristi manuelno izdavanje
računa, odgovarajući način plaćanja će biti unapred selektovan kod kreiranja računa.

Isporuka

Ako želite dodati cenu isporuke na fiskalni račun, uključite opciju “Dodati cenu isporuke na fiskalni račun”.
Ako kuirska služba naplaćuje dostavu, i izdaje poseban fiskalni račun, isključite opciju “Dodati cenu isporuke na fiskalni račun”.

Kreiranje fiskalnih računa manuelno

Nakon što ste završili korake podešavanja, NetRačuni plugin je spreman za izdavanje fiskalnih računa.
U detaljima narudžbe pojavi se dugme NetRačuni. Klikom na dugme pojavljuje se sekcija za kreiranje fiskalnih računa.
Ovde možete podesiti način plaćanja, i identifikaciju kupca. Identifikacija kupca nije neophodan, i uglavnom se koristi
kada želite izdavati gotovinski račun, tada izaberite PIB i upišite PIB kupca u polje ispod.
Više informacije o identifikaciji kupca pronađite u documentaciji poreske uprave.
Klikom na dugme “Kreiraj račun” podaci narudžbe se šalju u sistem NetRačuni i kreira se fiskalni račun.
Nakon uspešnog kreiranja računa pojavi se link za sačuvanje računa.

Automatsko izdavanje fiskalnog računa

Uključivanjem automatskog izdavanja fiskalnog računa, NetRačuni plugin automatsko kreira fiskalni račun, kada narudžba stigne u
status koju ste izabrali. Napomena: fiskalni račun se kreira automatski samo jednom. Ako već postoji fiskalni račun za narudžbu, tada
neće kreirati nov fiskalni račun, iako narudžba stigne u isti status više puta.
Kada koristite automatsko izdavanje računa, vodite računa da status koju podesite odgovara e-mail-u koju izaberete za fiskalni račun.
Na primer želite izdavanje računa na order completed: izaberite kreiranja računa na “Completed”, a e-mail isto “Order completed”.
Bitno je da e-mail koju izaberete mora da se šalje posle kreiranja računa, u suprotnom e-mail se šalje bez računa u prilogu.
Ako zbog nekog razloga želite ručno napraviti račun za neku narudžbu (na primer želite dodati PIB kupca), to možete uraditi
u sekciji NetRačuni. Vodite računa da ovaj korak morate raditi pre nego što narudžba stigne u fazu koju ste izabrali za automatsko
izdavanje računa. Ako ste manuelno napravili račun za narudžbu, neće se kreirati novi fiskalni račun. Manuelno kreiran račun će se slati
kao prilog uz e-mail koju ste izabrali.

Slanje fiskalnog računa kupcu

Fiskalni račun se šalje kupcu kao prilog uz e-mail koju izaberete (na primer completed order email).
U slučaju da je ovaj e-mail isključeno u WooCommerce podešavanjima (WooCommerce/Settings/Email), ili ste kreirali fiskalni račun nakon
slanja ovog e-maila, fiskalni račun snimajte iz sekcije NetRačuni i pošaljite kupcu ručno e-mailom ili drugim elektronskim putem (viber, whatsapp, messenger, itd)

Predračun, refundacija i ostale funkcije

Ovaj plugin podržava samo izdavanje fiskalnog računa “Promet prodaja”. Ako želite izdavati predračun, ili refundirati račun
to možete uraditi na korisničkom insterfejsu NetRačuni-a.

[English]

NetRačuni is an online fiscal cash register for online businesses.
This plugin allows you to issue fiscal invoices with a single click directly from your WooCommerce store.

Settings

After registering with the NetRačuni system, create an API token following the instructions.
Open the WooCommerce settings (WooCommerce > Settings > NetRačuni) and paste the API key into the “API token” field.
Choose the environment you want to use: either the test server or the live server.
After successfully saving the token (click on the “Save changes” button), a green dot will appear in the status section, indicating that your store has been successfully connected to the NetRačuni server.

Tax Rates

After successfully connecting to the NetRačuni server, options for setting tax rates will appear.

Setting the default tax rate
This tax rate will be used for products that do not have a specific tax rate set.
If all your products use the same tax rate, it is enough to set only the default tax rate.

Product-specific tax rates when the built-in tax module is disabled
If your products have different tax rates, you can configure this in the product details, under the NetRačuni tab. According to the
specifications of the Serbian Tax Administration, it is possible to add multiple tax rates for a single product.
When the built-in WooCommerce tax module is enabled, the NetRačuni tab will not appear in the product details.

Using the built-in WooCommerce tax module
When the built-in WooCommerce “Tax” module is enabled, all tax rates must be mapped to the tax rates of the tax administration.
For each WooCommerce tax rate, select the corresponding tax rate from the tax administration.
Make sure that the percentage of the WooCommerce tax rate matches the tax administration’s rate,
otherwise the tax calculation will differ between the store and the fiscal receipt!

Payment Methods

Setting the default payment method
This payment method will be used on the invoice when the built-in “Payment methods” are disabled and
automatic invoice generation is enabled in NetRačuni settings. When using manual invoice creation,
this payment method will be preselected when generating an invoice.

Using the built-in payment method
When the built-in WooCommerce “Payment methods” module is enabled, all payment methods must be mapped
to the payment methods of the tax administration.
For each WooCommerce payment method, select the corresponding payment method from the tax administration.
When automatic invoice generation is enabled, the selected payment method by the customer during checkout will
be used on the invoice. When using manual invoice creation, the corresponding payment method will be preselected
during invoice generation.

Shipping

If you want to add the delivery charge to the fiscal receipt, enable the option “Dodati cenu isporuke na fiskalni račun”.
If the courier service charges for delivery and issues a separate fiscal receipt, disable the option “Dodati cenu isporuke na fiskalni račun”.

Manually Creating Fiscal Invoices

After completing the setup steps, the NetRačuni plugin is ready for issuing fiscal invoices.
In the order details, the NetRačuni button will appear. Clicking the button opens a section for creating fiscal invoices.
Here you can set the payment method and customer identification. Customer identification is not required, and
is mostly used when you want to issue a cash invoice — in that case, select PIB and enter the customer’s PIB (tax ID)
in the field below.
For more information about customer identification, refer to the Tax Administration documentation: https://purs.gov.rs/eFiskalizacija/korisnicka_uputstva/8069/sifarnik-jedinstvenog-identifikacionog-broja-kupca.html
By clicking the “Create Invoice” button, the order data is sent to the NetRačuni system and a fiscal invoice is created.
After successfully creating the invoice, a link to download the invoice will appear.

Automatic Fiscal Invoice Generation

By enabling automatic fiscal invoice generation, the NetRačuni plugin will automatically create a fiscal invoice
when the order reaches the selected status.
Note: The fiscal invoice is created automatically only once. If a fiscal invoice already exists for an order,
a new one will not be created — even if the order reaches the same status again.

When using automatic invoice creation, make sure the selected status corresponds to the email you selected
for sending the fiscal invoice.
For example, if you want to issue invoices when the order is marked as “Completed”:
select invoice creation on “Completed”, and also choose the email “Order completed”.
It is important that the selected email is sent after the invoice is created —
otherwise, the email will be sent without the invoice attached.

If, for any reason, you want to manually create an invoice for an order (e.g., you want to add the customer’s PIB),
you can do this in the NetRačuni section.
Be aware that this must be done before the order reaches the status selected for automatic invoice creation.
If you manually create an invoice, a new fiscal invoice will not be generated automatically.
The manually created invoice will be sent as an attachment with the selected email.

Sending the Fiscal Invoice to the Customer

The fiscal invoice is sent to the customer as an attachment to the email you select
(for example, the completed order email).

If this email is disabled in WooCommerce settings (WooCommerce → Settings → Emails),
or if the fiscal invoice is created after this email has already been sent,
you should download the invoice from the NetRačuni section and send it to the customer manually via
email or another electronic method (Viber, WhatsApp, Messenger, etc).

Proforma Invoice, Refunds, and Other Features

This plugin only supports issuing fiscal invoices for “Sales Transactions.” If you wish to issue a proforma invoice or process a refund, you can do so through the NetRačuni user interface.
